what_it_shows: Drone shot over the Camaya Coast beach: a row of white lounge chairs on pale sand, with a red kayak on the water at the edge of the cove.
notes: YouTube channel 'MOMMA LEE' (vlogger, not the resort). 84-93s is a static stage shot with people, so the cut starts at 94s. A tiled logo appears around 111s and the end card after it, both outside the cut. Sand and loungers dominate; the cove water is only a small strip at the top right.
